audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Gragas Levels 2, 3 and 4-5 as 'Skill' and Level 6 outright to Gragas, on a 49.03% matchup whose own text says Garen owns levels 1-3 and executes with true damage.
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Skill, Skill, Skill. The content whys already say Garen wins 2, 3 and 4-5 ('don't contest it', 'out-damages a Gragas without W maxed', 'faster than your early Happy Hour can punish'), and whys[4] says level 6 is 'genuinely even' — not a Gragas row.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-3 -> Garen and row 4 -> Skill in both layers, with phases[0..4].why rewritten to state the mechanical reason. Proposed as one atomic chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldowns anywhere in the full layer; spikes were described as 'your committal tool' and 'your ultimate'.
audit.why: Decisive Strike is a flat 8s, Courage 22/19.5/17/14.5/12, Demacian Justice 120/100/80; Body Slam 14s at rank 1 and Explosive Cask 100s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, tradeGood and phases[4].why now carry the real numbers and name Demacian Justice's execute line.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never stated the two interactions that decide the lane: Decisive Strike silences (cancelling Barrel Roll and the rest of your combo mid-cast), and Courage grants tenacity on cast, which shortens your Body Slam stun. tradeBad also gave a whiffed Body Slam as '13 seconds'.
audit.why: Riot's Q text says the move-speed burst breaks slows and the empowered strike silences; the W text explicitly grants 'a shield and tenacity for a brief moment'. Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 — 14s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: tradeBad, dontsFull[2].d, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns now state the silence and the tenacity, with 14s corrected.

audit.why: The packet flagged 'His Decisive Strike' in whys[2] as a probable wrong name; it is the correct ability name preceded by a possessive pronoun.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins level 1 outright. Identify how Garen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Decisive Strike silences your Barrel Roll mid-cast and empowers his strike — concede level 1 and last-hit at max cask range.

edits.before: W damage reduction + sustain flips his return trade. Only take the trade when Garen's Courage is down.
edits.after: He gets a real level-2 trade: Q-silence into empowered auto, before Drunken Rage is maxed. Don't contest it.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Garen must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Still his: the 8s Decisive Strike cancels your combo mid-cast and his short empowered trade out-damages you before W max.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Courage's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: He trades and disengages on Perseverance's untargeted regen faster than early Happy Hour punishes it, until Drunken Rage is maxed.

edits.before: Explosive Cask both finishes kills and deletes engages — you choose the fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Garen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: At 6 your Body Slam into W-auto into Barrel Roll matches his kit — bait Courage and the silence, then commit. Stay above Demacian Justice's execute line.

edits.before: Q-poke Garen on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Barrel Roll from fog, Drunken Rage as he answers, Body Slam only once Decisive Strike's 8s silence is spent.

edits.before: Q-poke Garen on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Barrel Roll from fog, Drunken Rage as he answers, Body Slam only once Decisive Strike's 8s silence is spent.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Body Slam into Courage — the tenacity shrugs your stun and a whiffed E is 14s of downtime.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Body Slam into Courage — the tenacity shrugs your stun and a whiffed E is 14s of downtime.

edits.before: Damage reduction on cast. Burst once it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shield plus tenacity on cast, 22s at rank 1 — burst him once it is down or baited.

edits.before: - Garen Courage: matchup-defining — Damage reduction on cast. Burst once it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Garen Decisive Strike: matchup-defining — 8s flat, silences your combo mid-cast. - Courage: shield plus tenacity, 22s at rank 1 — burst once it is down. - Body Slam: 14s. - Explosive Cask: 100s, kill windows only.

notes: Chart flips proposed as one atomic group across both layers. Rows 4-6 are a live disagreement: the packet chart says Skill/Skill/Skill, but mirrorFindings says the garen__gragas audit flipped its chart to Garen through First item with Skill only at 2+ items. I followed the packet and the existing whys text (Skill at 6 and at first item) rather than inventing a Garen advantage; mirror-fix.js will need a ruling. Courage's tenacity is stated in Riot's own W text, so shortening the Body Slam stun is safe to assert; whether Explosive Cask's knockback interrupts Judgment is not answerable from the kits and I wrote no claim about it.
